rationale: Near-bus fault (0.2km) yields max 3-ph current 9.304 kA; remote-end (8.0km) yields min 2-ph current 1.508 kA. Required breaker rating = 9.304 × 1.1 = 10.234 kA → smallest available standard: 12.5 kA. Relay pickup must be between 360 × 1.25 = 450 A and 1508 / 2.0 = 754 A → selected 602 A.
